title.zh: 将达沃省班萨兰市镇马尔贝尔因特里奥尔小学的名称变更为新克拉林小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Marber Interior Elementary School in the Municipality of Bansalan, Province of Davao, to New Clarin Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Marber Interior Elementary School in the Municipality of Bansalan, Province of Davao, to New Clarin Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Marber Interior tại Thị trấn Bansalan, Tỉnh Davao thành Trường tiểu học New Clarin
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Marber Interior ในเทศบาล Bansalan, จังหวัด Davao เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา New Clarin
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Marber Interior di Kotamadya Bansalan, Provinsi Davao menjadi Sekolah Dasar New Clarin
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Marber Interior di Perbandaran Bansalan, Wilayah Davao menjadi Sekolah Rendah New Clarin

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1656_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Marber Interior Elementary School in the Municipality of Bansalan, Province of Davao, is changed to New Clarin Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 20, 1957.
